title: 公园美术课 · 分享邮件
story: 假定你是李华，上周五你们班在公园上了一堂美术课。请你给英国朋友 Chris 写一封邮件分享这次经历，内容包括：
1. 写作词数应为 80 个左右；
2. 请按如下格式在答题纸的相应位置作答。

step1.implied: 以朋友身份分享亲身经历——第一人称叙事，画面和真情是本钱
step1.feelings: 写成画技汇报或课堂总结（官方口吻），分享的亲切感消失

step1.implied: 朋友 + 跨文化：他没见过中国画课堂，画面细节对他是新鲜的
step1.feelings: 默认他懂背景（Last Friday's art class you know——他不知道）

step1.main: 分享邮件：分享上周五公园美术课的经历（题干明示）
step1.implied: 分享 ≠ 汇报 ≠ 教程——要让对方如临其境，不是交代事项
step1.feelings: 写成 How to paint 教程 / 或课堂流水账 I had a class

step1.main: 邮件，答题纸书信格式（Dear Chris, / Yours, / Li Hua 题干已给）
step1.implied: 三件套齐全 + 80 词上限
step1.feelings: 落款写 Yours sincerely（朋友间过重）；词数失控写到 130

step1.main: 分享这次经历（题干明示）——潜台词：让对方感受到这份快乐
step1.implied: 任务成功标准 = Chris 读完像同游了一次公园
step1.feelings: 写成日程汇报 I want to tell you about my Friday（有告知无画面）

step1.card: 我是李华，用邮件向英国朋友 Chris 分享上周五公园美术课的经历（我画了什么 + 我感受到什么），80 词，书信三件套。
step1.tag: ［非正式偏半正式 · 热在画面 · 联结配方：契合＋感情 · 时态：过去叙事＋现在感想］
step1.hint: 动笔前默念一遍——这句话就是全篇的锚。语用标签由②四问判定后回填。

step2.q: ① 交际目的：这封邮件最终要 Chris 得到什么？

opts.t: A. 知道你有这件事（告知型：有告知无画面）
opts.why: I had an art class in a park——干巴巴一条通知，朋友读完只会'哦'。

opts.t: B. 如临其境地共享这次经历（分享型：告知＋画面＋温度）
opts.why: 分享 = 高情感的告知：画面（湖、柳、夕阳）+ 真情（peaceful / rewarding）让他像同游了一次。

opts.t: C. 佩服我的画技（表现型）
opts.why: 炫耀笔法——朋友分享变个人画展，温度错位。

opts.t: D. 跟我学画画 / 给我建议（求助型）
opts.why: 题干没有这个任务——自加任务就是跑题。

step2.a: 落点 B。判断法：Chris 读完放下手机想回什么？B 型让他想回 That sounds amazing! 四型对照：通知=告知 · 邀请/请求=促成 · 申请=表现 · 分享=B 型（告知的温度版）。

step2.q: ② 关系定位：李华与 Chris 的关系落在标尺哪一格？

opts.t: A. 正式（对校长 / 陌生机构）
opts.why: 过冷——朋友之间用 I am writing to inform you 这类公文腔，友谊降级。

opts.t: B. 半正式偏正式（师长：亲切而恭敬）
opts.why: 多了一层敬意——朋友间没有权力差。

opts.t: C. 半正式平视（不熟的家长 / 房东）
opts.why: 礼貌而客气——朋友之间连'客气'都嫌外。

opts.t: D. 非正式（朋友：自然、亲近、有说笑）
opts.why: 英国朋友=平辈至交：I can't wait to tell you / It was so much fun 都合法；但书面邮件仍保基本规范（不用缩写狂欢 u2 / gonna）。

step2.a: 落点 D。语域标尺四格任何题先标位：通知/申请=正式 · 师长=偏正式 · 托不熟的人=平视 · 朋友=非正式。本题与'邀请外教'（B格）正好两极对照。

step2.q: ③ 情感分寸：这封邮件该多"热"？

opts.t: A. 越热越好（So amazing!!! I really really love it!!!）
opts.why: 感叹号轰炸=热度透支——真感情被噪声淹没。

opts.t: B. 热在画面，收在真情
opts.why: 热情端：让画面自己说话（a sparkling lake bathed in soft sunset light）；真挚端：一句 I absolutely loved it 收束——热而不闹。

opts.t: C. 公事公办，零度叙述
opts.why: Last Friday we had a painting class. I painted a picture.——日志不是分享。

opts.t: D. 克制疏离（像写给陌生人）
opts.why: 对朋友端着，联结就断了。

step2.a: 落点 B。分享型邮件的分寸：温度装在细节里，不装在感叹号里。

step2.q: ④ 联结路径：靠什么与 Chris 建立联结？

opts.t: A. 讲道理（Outdoor painting improves our aesthetic ability...）
opts.why: 跟朋友总结'户外写生的教育意义'——错位的说教。

opts.t: B. 给契合（艺术与自然——他感兴趣的世界）
opts.why: 联结通道①：画面细节（柳、湖、夕阳）邀他进入美的现场——共同审美的契合。

opts.t: C. 动感情（共享快乐与放松）
opts.why: 联结通道②：relieved my academic pressure——学业压力是中英学生共通的，他懂你。

opts.t: D. 抬身份（特邀您指导）
opts.why: 朋友间用不着 honor / would be grateful 这套——那是给师长的。

step2.a: 配方 B＋C（本题用不上 D）：契合是'带你看'，感情是'与你共'——朋友分享的两条通道全开，道理一句都不要。

step3.guide: 梯子爬到顶，就是思想性。本题的主体是"经历"，主梯选深度梯：作品（表：画了什么）→ 沉浸（里：体验如何）→ 感悟（顶：明白了什么）；感想段可用抽象梯收顶：具体经历 → 减压与'艺术源于生活'的价值。80 词选一把梯爬两三级即可。

items.name: 深度梯
items.extract: 作品 → 体验 → 感悟
items.reuse: painted a lively landscape featuring green willows（表·作品）→ Focusing on capturing natural beauty allowed me to enjoy every peaceful moment（里·沉浸）→ made me realize art originates from real life（顶·感悟）
items.effect: 适用：本题主梯——'你完成的作品+你的感想'两个要点正好是表和顶。

items.name: 高度梯
items.extract: 个人 → 集体 → 社会
items.reuse: I painted...（个人）→ my class had...（集体）→ such outdoor learning should be part of school life（社会）
items.effect: 适用：若感想写教育价值（家校社会层面）——本题空间有限，慎用。

items.name: 认知梯
items.extract: 了解 → 实践 → 创造
items.reuse: watched the teacher demonstrate（了解）→ painted on location（实践）→ created my own landscape（创造）
items.effect: 适用：若详写课堂过程（怎么上的课）。

items.name: 抽象梯
items.extract: 具体事实 → 意义价值
items.reuse: a painting class in a park（事实）→ a break from textbooks（意义）→ a reminder that art originates from real life（价值）
items.effect: 适用：感想段的收顶——从这堂课升华出价值，豹尾余韵常在这。

step3.patterns: 登梯衔接句式：What impressed me most was...（进一层）／ Not only did it..., but it also...（倒装递进）／ It was this experience that made me realize...（强调登顶）

build.pick: 本题两个要点一条主梯贯通：作品 → 深度梯（表里顶三级正好覆盖'作品+感想'）；感想收顶 → 抽象梯（经历→价值）。

runs.point: 要点①作品 + 要点②感想

steps.sent: I painted a lively landscape featuring green willows and a sparkling lake bathed in soft sunset light.
Focusing on capturing natural beauty allowed me to enjoy every peaceful moment.
It not only relieved my academic pressure but also made me realize art originates from real life.

runs.note: 三级用分词结构（featuring / bathed / Focusing）串成流动的叙事——这正是③猪肚里'作品与体验'的最终形态，范文原句即此梯。

steps.sent: a painting class in a city park
a peaceful break from academic pressure

runs.note: 从'一堂课'到'一个道理'——抽象梯三级是感想句的骨架，I absolutely loved this immersive way of learning 是收束的感情句。

step4.overview: 凤头引出分享 → 猪肚铺开画面与体验（作品在这里活起来）→ 豹尾收在感悟与期待——分享型邮件的脉络。

sections.goal: 3秒定向 + 定调：告诉 Chris 我要分享一件美事，第一句就带温度（非正式语域）
sections.micro: 呼语 → 分享句（I'm writing to share... / I can't wait to tell you...）
plots: 分享句：I'm writing to share a wonderful outdoor art experience...—— wonderful 一词定下全文温度
自检：Dear Chris 之后直接入事？—— 分享邮件不讲客套，第一句就把人带进现场

sections.goal: 作品活起来：画了什么（画面细节）+ 怎么画的（过程）+ 沉浸其中（体验）
sections.micro: 作品句 → 细节句（分词后置装画面）→ 体验句（层次怎么爬梯 → ④深度梯）
plots: 作品句：I painted a lively landscape featuring green willows and a sparkling lake...
细节句：...bathed in soft sunset light（分词给画面上光）
体验句：Focusing on capturing natural beauty allowed me to enjoy every peaceful moment.
自检：Chris 能'看见'这幅画吗？—— 没有细节就没有画面

sections.goal: 感悟收顶（抽象梯登顶）+ 期待回应（分享的闭环：说给你听，也想听你说）
sections.micro: 感悟句（not only... but also...）→ 期待句（Looking forward to...）
plots: 感悟句：It not only relieved my academic pressure but also made me realize art originates from real life.
自检：结尾有'我明白了什么'吗？—— 分享的落点是感悟，不是'That's all'

step5.src: 审题病 · 五维①内容连贯
step5.bad: Here is how to paint a landscape: first, choose a view; then, sketch the outline...
step5.good: I'm writing to share a wonderful outdoor art experience my class had last Friday in a city park.
step5.note: 分享经历写成画画教程——任务卡里'分享'变成了'教'。

step5.src: 审题病 · 五维①内容完整
step5.bad: I learned a lot from this class. It was meaningful and fun.
step5.good: I painted a lively landscape featuring green willows and a sparkling lake... It made me realize art originates from real life.
step5.note: 只有感想没有作品（要点①丢了）——两个要点是'作品+感想'，缺一即掉档。

step5.src: 审题病 · 五维⑤格式规范
step5.bad: Friday, Sunny. Today my class had a painting class in the park...
step5.good: Dear Chris, ... Looking forward to your reply! Yours, Li Hua
step5.note: 日记体混入邮件——题干给的是书信格式（①的 Where? 白答了）。

step5.src: 审题病 · 五维③得体性
step5.bad: My class went to a park. The teacher guided them and they painted happily.
step5.good: Guided by our teacher, I painted a lively landscape...
step5.note: 自己的经历写成他们（them/they）——分享的是 I 的经历，不是班级新闻。

step5.src: 基调病 · 五维③得体性
step5.bad: You should try painting outdoors. It is good for your health.
step5.good: I absolutely loved this immersive way of learning. Looking forward to your reply!
step5.note: 对朋友说教（should）+ 功利（good for health）——分享的温度变成推销（②情感分寸的落点）。

step5.src: 结构病 · 五维④结构流畅
step5.bad: I painted a picture. It was tiring. The park has a lake. I like willows. The class was fun.
step5.good: 作品句（画面）→ 体验句（沉浸）→ 感悟句（收顶）——凤引出、猪铺开、豹收束。
step5.note: 碎片跳切：作品没画完就跳感想又跳回树——③凤猪豹各归其位。

step5.src: 结构病 · 五维①内容完整
step5.bad: The painting was beautiful. The park was beautiful. Everything was so beautiful.
step5.good: I painted a lively landscape featuring green willows and a sparkling lake bathed in soft sunset light.
step5.note: 三连 beautiful 不如一次具体呈现——猪肚要分层（画面/体验/感悟），不要同层复读。

step5.src: 建构病 · 五维②层次性
step5.bad: It was very interesting and I learned a lot from the class.
step5.good: Focusing on capturing natural beauty allowed me to enjoy every peaceful moment.
step5.note: '学到了很多'是贴标签——画面细节上句才是内容（④深度梯的'表'一级）。

checks.q: 感想只会 interesting / learned a lot？上细节

step5.src: 建构病 · 五维②思想性
step5.bad: I was happy that day. Painting is fun.
step5.good: It not only relieved my academic pressure but also made me realize art originates from real life.
step5.note: 梯子只爬到'开心'就停——登顶（art originates from real life）才见思想（④深度梯的'顶'）。

step5.src: 建构病 · 五维②思想性
step5.bad: With the development of society, art education is becoming more and more important...
step5.good: When it comes to last Friday, the first thing that springs to my mind is our painting class in the city park.
step5.note: 万金油开头+意义先行——从本题的具体情境（那堂课、那片湖）切入才是分享。

step5.src: 语言病 · 五维③丰富性
step5.bad: The park was nice. I painted a picture. It was good. I was happy.
step5.good: I painted a lively landscape featuring green willows and a sparkling lake bathed in soft sunset light.
step5.note: 通篇主谓宾+good/happy——升级路径见⑥语料（分词装画面、倒装收顶）。

checks.q: 结尾只会 I was happy？

step5.src: 语言病 · 五维⑤语法规范
step5.bad: Last Friday my class have a painting class. We paint in the park and I finish a picture.
step5.good: Last Friday my class had a painting class. We painted in the park and I finished a landscape.
step5.note: 叙事主色调=过去时（上周五！）——'这封信活在什么时间里'动笔前定调（写信此刻 am writing + 经历过去 + 感悟现在完成/现在）。

qs.q: 分享起手句（功能句 + 温度定调）

corpus.tell: I want to tell you about my Friday.
corpus.show: I am writing to share a wonderful outdoor art experience my class had last Friday.
I can't wait to tell you about our painting class in the park!

corpus.tell: I painted a picture of a lake.
corpus.show: I painted a lively landscape featuring green willows and a sparkling lake bathed in soft sunset light.

corpus.tell: There were trees near the lake and the sun was setting.
corpus.show: With the sun sinking behind the willows, the lake turned gold.

qs.q: 过程句（过去叙事 + 被动）

corpus.tell: The teacher taught us and we began to paint.
corpus.show: Guided by our teacher, we set up our easels and began to capture the scenery.

corpus.tell: We were taken to the park by our teacher.
corpus.show: Our teacher led us to the lakeside, where the whole class painted on location.

corpus.tell: I enjoyed the time very much.
corpus.show: Focusing on capturing natural beauty allowed me to enjoy every peaceful moment.

corpus.tell: The class was interesting and I was quiet.
corpus.show: What impressed me most was the silence — only brushes, breeze and birdsong.

qs.q: 感悟句（倒装递进 + 强调登顶）

corpus.tell: It relaxed me and taught me something.
corpus.show: Not only did it relieve my academic pressure, but it also made me realize art originates from real life.

corpus.tell: This class made me understand art.
corpus.show: It was this experience that made me realize where art truly comes from — real life.
I absolutely loved this immersive way of learning.

corpus.tell: This class was good for students.
corpus.show: Such outdoor lessons are truly a feast for both mind and eyes.
Looking forward to hearing about your latest adventures!
How about sharing with me something fun from your side?

fuyao: 分享事由（上周五、美术课、公园）
你完成的作品（画了什么+画面细节）
书信三件套 + 期待回应

step8.text:
Dear Chris,

I'm writing to share a wonderful outdoor art experience my class had last Friday in a city park.

Guided by our teacher, I painted a lively landscape featuring green willows and a sparkling lake bathed in soft sunset light. Focusing on capturing natural beauty allowed me to enjoy every peaceful moment.

This outdoor painting experience was truly rewarding. It not only relieved my academic pressure but also made me realize art originates from real life. I absolutely loved this immersive way of learning.

Looking forward to your reply!

Yours,
Li Hua

eval.comment: 两要点全覆盖：作品（landscape featuring willows and lake）+ 感想（rewarding / realize art originates），从 share 起手到 reply 收束——①的任务卡在这篇里完整兑现。
深度梯三级一气贯通：画了什么（表）→ 沉浸自然之美（里）→ 艺术源于生活（顶）——④本篇建构的示范句正是本篇范文，梯子爬到了顶。
三个分词结构（Guided by / featuring / bathed in / Focusing on）装出流动画面；对朋友的自然语域（wonderful / absolutely loved）不端不装——②D 格非正式的教科书示范。
凤13·猪52·豹9（右侧词数体检可验证）：凤头一句带入现场，猪肚铺开画面与体验，豹尾感悟收顶+期待回应——③三段各司其职。
叙事过去时主色调（had / painted / allowed / relieved）+写信此刻进行（I'm writing）+感悟现在（originates）——时态三层各就各位；三件套齐全，95 词达标——⑤语言病一条不犯。
